name: muovi
description:
Muovi is a marketplace for home and local services in the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina. This connector lets an assistant help someone find a professional on Muovi and prepare a task for them.

What it does:
- Lists the service categories Muovi supports (62, from plumbing, electricity and gas to cleaning, moving and appliance repair) and the 47 neighborhoods of Buenos Aires it covers.
- Searches professionals for one service in one neighborhood and returns up to five, with their public profile, rating and the reason each one matched.
- Reads a professional's public profile and reviews.
- Reads the questions Muovi asks for a service, so the assistant can collect the details of the job.
- Saves a task draft on Muovi and returns a link, or builds a link to start a task with one professional.

What it does not do:
- It does not publish anything. The person opens the link, reviews the draft, signs in to Muovi and publishes the task themselves.
- It does not return phone numbers, email addresses or WhatsApp contacts.
- It does not take payments or move money.

No account is needed to connect. A Muovi account is needed only to publish a task. Muovi's content and the questions it asks are in Spanish.

capabilities: Search professionals by service and neighborhood
Prepare a task draft the person publishes on Muovi
defaultPrompt: Find a plumber in Palermo, Buenos Aires on Muovi
Prepare a Muovi task to fix a leaking kitchen tap in Almagro
Show me reviews for an electrician in Caballito on Muovi

positive.description: Finding professionals for a service in a named neighborhood.
positive.prompt: I need a plumber in Palermo, Buenos Aires. Who is available on Muovi?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant resolves the service to the slug plomeria and the neighborhood to palermo, calls muovi_search_professionals with both, and presents up to 5 professionals with name, rating and a link to each public profile on muovi.com.ar. No phone number, email or WhatsApp contact appears.

positive.description: The search needs a neighborhood; the assistant asks for it instead of searching without one.
positive.prompt: Find me an electrician on Muovi.
positive.tools_triggered: muovi_list_services (optionally muovi_list_cities); muovi_search_professionals only after the person names a neighborhood
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant asks which neighborhood of Buenos Aires the job is in. Once the person answers (for example Caballito), it searches with service electricidad and that neighborhood and lists up to 5 professionals.

positive.description: Reading one professional's profile and reviews after a search.
positive.prompt: Show me more about the first plumber in Palermo and what clients say about them.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant uses the id of a search result to fetch the public profile (headline, bio, services, verifications, profile link) and the most recent reviews (rating, comment, reduced author name such as "María G."), and summarises them.

positive.description: Preparing a complete task draft by asking Muovi's questions for the service.
positive.prompt: My kitchen tap is leaking. I'm in Almagro, Buenos Aires. Prepare a task on Muovi so plumbers can send me quotes.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reads the requirements for plomeria, asks the person the required questions it cannot answer from the message, then calls muovi_create_task_draft with the description, the location and the answers. It returns a muovi.com.ar link and explains that the person opens it, reviews the draft, signs in and publishes. It does not say the task was published.

positive.description: Starting a task with one chosen professional.
positive.prompt: I want to ask the second professional from that list for a quote. Give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls muovi_create_task_link with that professional's id and the service slug and returns a muovi.com.ar link to Muovi's task form for that professional. It explains that the person completes and publishes the task on Muovi.

negative.description: Contact details are not available through the connector; contact happens on Muovi.
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number or WhatsApp of the best plumber in Palermo.

negative.description: The connector cannot publish a task or hire on the person's behalf; it only prepares a draft the person publishes.
negative.prompt: Publish the task for me and hire the cheapest professional, I don't want to open any link.

negative.description: Muovi covers the City of Buenos Aires; a request outside it has no results and the assistant should say so.
negative.prompt: Find me a plumber in Madrid, Spain on Muovi.

es-419.subtitle: Servicios para el hogar, CABA
es-419.description:
Muovi es un marketplace de servicios para el hogar y servicios locales en la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, Argentina. Este conector permite que un asistente ayude a una persona a encontrar un profesional en Muovi y a preparar una tarea.

Qué hace:
- Lista las categorías de servicio de Muovi (62, desde plomería, electricidad y gas hasta limpieza, mudanzas y reparación de electrodomésticos) y los 47 barrios de Buenos Aires que cubre.
- Busca profesionales para un servicio en un barrio y devuelve hasta cinco, con su perfil público, su calificación y el motivo por el que coincide cada uno.
- Lee el perfil público y las reseñas de un profesional.
- Lee las preguntas que Muovi hace para un servicio, para que el asistente reúna los detalles del trabajo.
- Guarda un borrador de tarea en Muovi y devuelve un enlace, o arma un enlace para iniciar una tarea con un profesional.

Qué no hace:
- No publica nada. La persona abre el enlace, revisa el borrador, inicia sesión en Muovi y publica la tarea.
- No devuelve números de teléfono, direcciones de correo ni contactos de WhatsApp.
- No cobra pagos ni mueve dinero.

No hace falta una cuenta para conectarlo. Solo se necesita una cuenta de Muovi para publicar una tarea. El contenido de Muovi y sus preguntas están en español.

ru-RU.subtitle: Услуги для дома, Буэнос-Айрес
ru-RU.description:
Muovi — это маркетплейс бытовых и местных услуг в городе Буэнос-Айрес, Аргентина. Этот коннектор позволяет ассистенту помочь человеку найти специалиста на Muovi и подготовить для него заявку.

Что он делает:
- Показывает категории услуг Muovi (62: от сантехники, электрики и газа до уборки, переездов и ремонта бытовой техники) и 47 районов Буэнос-Айреса, в которых работает сервис.
- Ищет специалистов по одной услуге в одном районе и возвращает до пяти человек с публичным профилем, рейтингом и причиной, по которой каждый подошёл.
- Читает публичный профиль специалиста и отзывы о нём.
- Читает вопросы, которые Muovi задаёт по услуге, чтобы ассистент собрал детали работы.
- Сохраняет черновик заявки на Muovi и возвращает ссылку или формирует ссылку для создания заявки одному специалисту.

Чего он не делает:
- Ничего не публикует. Человек открывает ссылку, проверяет черновик, входит в Muovi и публикует заявку сам.
- Не возвращает номера телефонов, адреса электронной почты и контакты WhatsApp.
- Не принимает платежи и не переводит деньги.

Для подключения аккаунт не нужен. Аккаунт Muovi нужен только для публикации заявки. Контент Muovi и его вопросы — на испанском языке.
